sources.title: Mike Henry, businessman
sources.findings: Explicit birth year 1966; BMA secondment in 2001 and permanent BHP entry in 2003; chemistry degree.
sources.caution: Secondary source for birth year only; no exact day. Primary biography confirms education and career but not birth year. Infobox CEO title is stale despite former-role wording in the body.

sources.title: Appointment announcement and historical biography
sources.findings: CEO appointment effective 1 January 2020; UBC BSc in Chemistry; born in Canada. Career table distinguishes Mitsubishi, BMA secondment and BHP roles; Minerals Australia from February 2016.
sources.caution: The URL path 2021/05 is not the appointment date. This is a historical announcement, not a current office roster. No graduation year, engineering degree or dual nationality inferred.

sources.title: 18March2026 CEO succession announcement
sources.findings: CEO until 30 June 2026; support and employment planned until 30 November 2026. Includes a farewell statement attributed directly to Henry.
sources.caution: 30 November remains in the future at the cutoff. Corporate praise is not an independent audit; Craig biography must not be attributed to Henry.

sources.title: 1July2026 director retirement filing
sources.findings: Confirms Executive Director retirement on 30 June 2026 and provides the final director interest notice.
sources.caution: 1 July filing date differs from 30 June retirement. Departure from the board does not establish the end of employment.

sources.title: Current board and management roster
sources.findings: Brandon Craig is current CEO, effective 1 July 2026; Ross McEwan is Chair. Henry is not on the current board roster.
sources.caution: Roster establishes office succession, not personal activity. Other executive changes are not attributed to Henry.

sources.title: Petroleum merger completion and shareholder information
sources.findings: Petroleum merger completed on 1 June 2022; Woodside shares distributed to BHP shareholders as an in-specie dividend.
sources.caution: This was the petroleum business merger, not a merger of all BHP or a personal purchase. Economic effective date and completion date differ; anticipated benefits are not guaranteed.

sources.title: 2May2023 OZ Minerals completion
sources.findings: Confirms completed acquisition of all OZ Minerals shares through a BHP subsidiary; includes Henry statement on copper and nickel.
sources.caution: Completed acquisition differs from April court approval. Resources and shares are corporate assets, not personal holdings.

sources.title: 29May2024 Anglo American statement
sources.findings: Rule 2.8 statement confirms BHP would not make a firm offer. Henry attributes the disagreement to regulatory risk and cost.
sources.caution: Read the opening statement, not all legal notices. This concerns the 2024 attempt, not a permanent prohibition or a completed takeover. Company explanations remain attributed.

sources.title: 17February2026 investor briefing transcript,session2
sources.findings: Opening identifies Henry as a participant in the results Q&A, discussing capital allocation and copper guidance.
sources.caution: Read the opening, not all seven pages. Reporting period ended 31 December 2025; 2027 guidance is not achieved production.
